evidence: high (poster removed the film, first layer good)
machine: Voron Trident (same found on his V0)
cause: protective film left on the spring-steel sheet, shrinks and ruffles with heat
opener: There is a low spot on the bed that seems to wander around, and the bed meshes look terrible and change from one print to the next.

evidence: high (poster confirmed after many hours of printing)
cause: missing ground wire; an extra ground from the PSU fixed it
opener: Only about 1 in 3 prints completes. 30 minutes or more into a print I get TMC GSTAT errors: the extruder driver reports a reset and the X or Y driver reports undervoltage. I already replaced the controller board and the power supply, lowered the motor currents and removed the LEDs.

cause: wrong nozzle type (too short), gap at the threads
opener: I keep getting plastic oozing through the threads and down the outside of the nozzle. The manufacturer sent me a new heater block but that did not fix it.

cause: tension screw insert faulty, too little grip on the filament
opener: Since I switched from ABS to PLA the extrusion is inconsistent and I hear clicking. I replaced the hotend and nozzle without improvement. When I open the extruder the gear teeth are filled with ground filament.

cause: kink in the filament on the spool, high resistance in the filament path
opener: On tall prints, at around 8 inches height, the layers start to look like they are splitting. When I extrude by hand the line starts thick and smooth and then gets thin and rough, and the filament tube jerks.

The printer randomly freezes during prints, after 20, 35, 60 or 80 minutes. The web page and the screen stop responding, only a power cycle helps. There are no errors in any log. I changed USB cables, ports and the Pi power supply.

cause: loose nozzle leaking at the threads
opener: After long prints I found blobs of old filament color getting deposited on new prints. Under the silicone sock there is a large blob of plastic around the heater block and the thermistor.
